Costed options per unit: keep, intervene, convert (spec 072, actions.md)

Source: R/p4_actions.R
p4_options.Rd

For each eligible unit (not signal only, and either under the decision threshold, or marked by a hazard above seuil_alea, or concentrating), builds at most three options. Each option carries p4_net_apres, recomputed by indicateur_p4_rendement_net() on inputs modified by the rules (points added to the score of the dominant hazard, share of the capital harvested, gain factor), its qualitative effects +, 0, - on the axes, and the mark of dominated options (at least as good on p4_net_apres and on every axis, strictly better on one).

Usage

p4_options(
  ugf_p4,
  regles = NULL,
  ruine = NULL,
  axes = c("B", "N"),
  axes_proteges_profil = NULL,
  parametres = NULL,
  id_field = NULL,
  vocation_field = "vocation",
  capital_field = "capital",
  gain_field = "gain_valeur",
  perte_saisie_field = "perte_saisie",
  garde_profil = NULL
)

Arguments

ugf_p4

Output of indicateur_p4_rendement_net() (with its input columns: vocation, capital, gain, R*_norm, area).

regles

Rules, default p4_regles_actions().

ruine

Output of p4_ruine_foret(), or NULL.

axes

Columns of ugf_p4 (family columns such as famille_biodiversite, or family letters) whose effects are reported.

axes_proteges_profil

Family letters protected by the actor profile (added to those of the vocation).

parametres

P4 parameters, default p4_parametres().

id_field, vocation_field, capital_field, gain_field, perte_saisie_field

Column names, as in indicateur_p4_rendement_net().

garde_profil

NULL or a function of the option table returning one logical per row (TRUE = keep); guard 3, supplied by the application.

Value

A data frame, one row per unit and option: ugf, option, libelle, tableau, recolte, delta_score, prelevement_capital, facteur_gain, p4_net_avant, p4_net_apres, delta_p4, p4_ecart_apres, effet_<lettre> for each axis, cout_indicatif_eur_ha (NA: no cost parameter), dominee, dominee_par, statut (retenable, dominee, ecartee_axe_protege, ecartee_profil), arbitrage_axes, garde, version_parametres, version_regles and regles_provisoires.

Details

Guards, which are invariants of the code that no rules file can lower: 1 vocation (outside production and mixed, or for a unit to capitalise, any option that harvests falls back on its sans_recolte variant, so that recolte holds exactly when prelevement_capital > 0 and the tableau is coupes) and 4 precision (NDP floor of 3), 5 extent (the harvest is capped by prelevement_max_part_capital, never a clear-cut), 2 protected axes (an option rated - on an axis protected by the vocation or by axes_proteges_profil is ecartee_axe_protege, or, with axes_proteges_mode: arbitrage, kept with the axes listed in arbitrage_axes), 3 through garde_profil. The option conserver is the reference status quo: it is always presented, and marked dominee = TRUE when it is dominated, but never discarded. The effects are expert hypotheses, never measures. The gain on the dominant hazard is added to every score the hazard reads (R3_norm and R5_norm for the drought and health hazard), so it raises the minimum; it has no effect on a unit with perte_saisie (its entered loss is kept) or on a score already at 100. Lowering the capital raises the gross yield without counting the income of the harvest (model hypothesis, to be reviewed).

Examples

u <- data.frame(vocation = "production", capital = 11000, gain_valeur = 380,
                surface_ha = 6, R1_norm = 75, R2_norm = 30, R3_norm = 20, R4_norm = 85,
                B = 30, N = 20)
u <- suppressMessages(indicateur_p4_rendement_net(u, ndp = 3))
p4_options(u)[, c("option", "p4_net_apres", "statut")]
#>       option p4_net_apres    statut
#> 1  conserver   0.01564545 retenable
#> 2 intervenir   0.01953232 retenable
#> 3  convertir   0.01588182 retenable
